bhajan.title: Allah Eshwar Terey Naam Karuna Sindhu Sai Ram

discourse.excerpt: The welfare of the world depends on the welfare of Society; the welfare of Society depends on the welfare of the individuals who comprise it. For, manava seva (the service of man) is really Madhava seva (service offered to God).
discourse.theme: The world's welfare rests on society's, and society's on each individual's — service to man is service to God.
discourse.title: Where and Why

reflection: Swami says the welfare of the world rests on society, and society's on each individual — and service to man is service to God. Today, serve one person as if serving God, and the world grows a little better. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 11, 22 Dec 1971)
seva_nudge: Join the Sai Prema Nilayam Riverside seva team this week — help serve food or pack grocery kits for families in need — or serve one neighbour as you would serve God.
